description: The routed write smoke on Ubuntu 24.04 under WSL2 with Docker Engine inside the distro (moved from .github/workflows/wsl2-smoke.yml, #1300): WS1 records and requires a real WSL2 kernel, WS2 installs Docker Engine and the Linux tools, WS3 builds and installs the candidate CLI, WS4 runs scripts/wsl2-smoke.sh, WS5 collects diagnostics. Manual runs only; Docker Desktop integration is not tested.
